sloka: तं ब्रुवाणं तथा वाक्यं लवणं घोरदर्शनम् ।शत्रुघ्नो देवशत्रुघ्न इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ७.६९.३ ॥
transliteration: taṁ bruvāṇaṁ tathā vākyaṁ lavaṇaṁ ghoradarśanam ।śatrughno devaśatrughna idaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 7.69.3 ॥

translations.english: To Lavaṇa, who was speaking such words and had a terrible appearance, Shatrughna, the destroyer of the gods' enemy, spoke these words.
